messages:
Nina: Quick sync on the Playground streaming UI 3 proposing a slightly different affordance for interrupting generation.
Nina: Idea: replace 'Stop' with 'Freeze' (keeps partial text locked for review), and surface two actions: 'Try again' and 'Continue generating'.
Omar: 'Freeze' reads neat but might confuse non-technical users. Could we add an inline tooltip: 'Freeze = keep partial output'? :question:
Becky: Token counter concern: when you Freeze we should show 'tokens so far' vs 'final tokens' once generation completes. Otherwise users assume billing already happened.
Liam: Agree. Proposal for counter: small badge that says '~45 tokens (in-progress)' then swap to '45 tokens' on completion. Make the badge aria-live polite.
Kai: Accessibility: when the stream is interrupted we need a live-region announcement. Suggested: 'Generation paused. Partial response visible. Press Continue to resume or Try again to create a new response.'
Nina: UX trade: showing both Try again and Continue could lead to accidental regen taps. What if Try again is under a kebab and Continue is primary?
Omar: I think Try again should be primary; most users hit regen after a poor response. We should A/B test this.
Becky: Prompt-library integration: if the user regenerates, auto-save the prompt+settings as a historic variant with a 'regenerated' tag to help debug prompt iterations.
Liam: Nice. UI note: prompt library row should show token delta and a small diff icon.
Kai: Keyboard shortcuts: propose 'f' for Freeze, 'c' for Continue, 't' for Try again. Document in keyboard help and show on hover; check for conflicts.
Nina: Microcopy candidates: 'Freeze output'/'Continue generation'/'Try again' vs 'Pause'/'Resume'/'Regenerate'. Which reads clearest?
Omar: Vote: Pause/Resume/Regenerate is familiar and lower cognitive load. Freeze maps to locking though. Maybe run a quick poll.
Becky: Flagging billing: are in-progress tokens provisional? Don't finalize billing until stream completes or user confirms. Need input from billing.
Liam: Implementation note: Continue should reuse same session & KV cache. Try again should start a new session and optionally reset chat-level cache. I'll add PR link later.
design-bot: Updated mockups with both label sets and token badge states -> https://figma.com/file/stream-labels (frames attached). Accessibility notes added.
design-bot: @channel Frames: freeze-flow-v1, pause-flow-v1, token-badge-states.
Nina: A/B plan: cohort A (Freeze/Try again/Continue) vs cohort B (Pause/Regenerate/Resume). Metrics: accidental regen rate, time-to-first-action, token confusion support tickets. Start with 2% traffic for 2 weeks.
Omar: Add instrumentation events: 'partial_viewed', 'continue_clicked', 'tryagain_clicked' and include token counts in payload.
Becky: I'll draft the prompt-library tagging spec and token-badge copy.
Liam: I'll coordinate with runtime on session semantics & KV-cache kill switch for Try again.
Kai: I'll produce aria text and keyboard shortcut doc and run it by accessibility.
Nina: I'll assemble the rollout doc and schedule a 30m sync next Tues. Thanks! :sparkles:
